g.text: C9 near U2; C7/C8 near U4. No crystal or reset pull-up required.

g.desc: C9 near U2; C7/C8 near U4. No crystal or reset pull-up required.

g.text: U4 DTR13 / RTS14 retain the two-transistor ESP32 auto-reset circuit.

g.desc: U4 DTR13 / RTS14 retain the two-transistor ESP32 auto-reset circuit.

g.text: Use WCH CH340 drivers and esptool default DTR/RTS reset.

g.desc: Use WCH CH340 drivers and esptool default DTR/RTS reset.

g.text: Disable terminal hardware flow control. No external USB ESD array.

g.desc: Disable terminal hardware flow control. No external USB ESD array.

g.text: USB POWER: NO ISOLATION / ONE CABLE ONLY

g.desc: USB POWER: NO ISOLATION / ONE CABLE ONLY

g.text: WARNING: CONNECT ONLY ONE USB CABLE AT A TIME.

g.desc: WARNING: CONNECT ONLY ONE USB CABLE AT A TIME.

g.text: Both connector VBUS pins are directly tied to +5V.

g.desc: Both connector VBUS pins are directly tied to +5V.

g.text: No reverse-current protection, even with ports on the same PC.

g.desc: No reverse-current protection, even with ports on the same PC.

g.text: CH340C has no separate VBUS sense input; divider removed.
